recovery_postmortem.saved_data: all 333 labeled roots and all 720 existing development traces
recovery_postmortem.counterfactual: use the frozen learned first option once at its original root, then frozen nominal to the same deadline; compare existing repeatedly controlled and nominal trajectories
recovery_postmortem.decision: If physical/control replay mismatches, classify the exact engineering defect. If one-shot improves versus repeat, repeated intervention is causally harmful for those matched cases; do not infer that it is the sole cause. If first option is already harmful, test value-ranking error on that root. No repair or retraining follows either outcome.
recovery_postmortem.stop: stop by 15 percent budget even if cause is unresolved

nominal_discovery.cohort: existing 240 nominal episodes, cases100-139 across six scenes; no new cohort
nominal_discovery.scope: already observed developmental cases; held-out mechanism checks are not fresh population confirmation
nominal_discovery.record: full action reward/value/safety decomposition, executable commands, selected pedestrian sets, physical state, legal history, recorded and replayed action

candidate_conditions.value_overrides_progress: selected predicted progress <=0; another same-mask action has progress >=0.02m and immediate reward >=selected+0.01
candidate_conditions.safety_blocks_progress: best progress action is masked while selected does not progress
candidate_conditions.empty_safe_set: no candidate has native .2m endpoint clearance
candidate_conditions.support_switch: different candidate poses select different nearest-five human ID sets; a descriptive design property, not automatically a defect

nominal_discovery.counterfactual_rule: Choose at most one repeated, source-supported mechanism from the discovery ledger. Register exact root selection and action catalog before continuation results. Same physical state, time, safety, and native dynamics. Do not invent a candidate if none qualifies.
nominal_discovery.go_method: a repeated task-loss mechanism with causal counterfactual support, valid deployment information/action support, and a specific gap not already absorbed by a simple baseline or closest prior
nominal_discovery.stop_no_gap: only engineering/environment artifacts, no reproducible task consequence, or strongest simple explanation suffices
nominal_discovery.escalate: one unresolved confound directly changes whether an algorithm gap exists; save reproducer and precise competing explanations instead of launching another long task

deliverables: case index and raw diagnostic evidence
